name: local-llm-harness
description: Drive a local or LAN-hosted llama.cpp model from VS Code with approval-gated workspace tools and optional verified Docker-sandboxed command rules.

commands.title: Please stage changes before generating a commit message.
Please stage changes before generating a commit message.

localLlmHarness.endpoint.description: URL of the llama.cpp server. Use localhost or a private IP literal such as http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 or http://192.168.1.50:8080/v1; DNS hostnames are refused.

localLlmHarness.modelFamily.description: How the served model's output is parsed for tool calls and reasoning. 'gemma4' = Gemma native <|tool_call> blocks; 'qwen3' = Qwen/ChatML (Hermes <tool_call> JSON, <think> reasoning).

localLlmHarness.contextSize.description: Total context window of the model (tokens).

localLlmHarness.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for chat requests. Lower is more deterministic, higher more varied. Agentic tool use needs exact line numbers and arguments, so the default is deliberately low.

localLlmHarness.topK.description: Top-k sampling: keep only the K most likely tokens at each step (0 disables).

localLlmHarness.topP.description: Top-p (nucleus) sampling: keep the smallest token set whose cumulative probability reaches p (1 disables).

localLlmHarness.autoCompact.description: Automatically compact context when usage reaches the configured threshold.

localLlmHarness.autoCompactThresholdPerc.description: Context usage percentage at which auto-compaction runs.

localLlmHarness.tailBudgetPercent.description: Share of the context window (percent) reserved for keeping the most recent messages verbatim through compaction.

localLlmHarness.maxMessageTokensPercent.description: Per-message size cap (percent of the context window). A single message larger than this (e.g. a big file read or command output) is middle-truncated with an elision marker so it can never overflow the context on its own.

localLlmHarness.templateOverheadTokensPe.description: Approximate chat-template/special tokens llama.cpp adds per message. Added to the exact /tokenize counts so the context guard does not under-count the rendered prompt.

localLlmHarness.autoapproveReads.description: Auto-approve read_file / list_dir / glob tool calls. Off by default; reads otherwise require explicit approval.

localLlmHarness.autoapproveWrites.description: Auto-approve file edit tool calls (workspace only).

localLlmHarness.autoapproveSandboxComman.description: Auto-approve configured structured sandbox command rules after a verified sandbox capability is available. Off by default.

localLlmHarness.sandboxDockerPath.description: Absolute path to the local Docker CLI used by the sandbox runner. Blank keeps command execution unavailable.

localLlmHarness.sandboxDockerHost.description: Optional local Docker endpoint (unix:// or npipe://). Blank uses the platform-local Docker default; network endpoints are rejected.

localLlmHarness.sandboxImage.description: Immutable sandbox image digest or image ID, such as repo/image@sha256:<64 lowercase hex characters>. Mutable tags are rejected.

localLlmHarness.sandboxCommands.description: Closed list of structured command rules. The model selects only a rule ID; each executable must be a regular non-link binary in the image, and executable, arguments, and working directory are fixed here and never parsed as a shell command.

id.description: Stable lowercase ASCII rule identifier presented to the model.

executable.description: Fixed canonical absolute POSIX executable passed directly as argv[0], without a shell.

args.description: Fixed argument vector passed directly to the executable.

cwd.description: Optional canonical workspace-relative working directory inside the disposable copy.

description.description: Short prompt-facing purpose of this fixed rule.

localLlmHarness.autoapproveCommands.description: Deprecated compatibility setting. It is ignored and never approves command execution; use autoapproveSandboxCommands for verified structured rules.

localLlmHarness.safeCommands.description: Deprecated compatibility setting. Regex entries are retained only so old user settings remain readable; they are never evaluated and never authorize execution.

match.description: Legacy inert regex text; never evaluated.
